text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of the spring Tenno Sho—one of the most important races to the Mejiro family—has arrived.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Bright, bursting with motivation, vows to run the same way Mejiro McQueen did when she won.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If successful, she'll become the first Mejiro since McQueen to win the spring Tenno Sho. The curtains are about to rise over a very important stage.
